title: Social signals: organisations' public posts, by link
what: Links to recent public posts by the official accounts of organisations (câmaras, public bodies, venues, organisers, news outlets, companies) on Bluesky and Mastodon, with metadata only: account, time, matched topics and places, language, media or not. No post text or media is stored.
publisher: The organisations themselves, through Bluesky (public AppView API) and Mastodon (public instance API)

schedule.how: the Pages workflow (.github/workflows/pages.yml) at 17 minutes past 00, 06, 12 and 18 UTC; every other hourly run keeps the last read, copied from the live site

terms.summary: Organisations only, official interfaces only, by link. Bluesky: robots.txt of the public API allows crawling it and asks for backoff on 429; the Terms of Service (14 Aug 2025) leave each post's content with its author, so we store link and metadata only and credit the organisation. Mastodon: mastodon.social's terms (effective 2026-08-31) say whoever owns the content retains ownership and allow API access; its robots.txt disallows only /media_proxy/, /interact/ and a domain-blocks path. Licence on each post: the platform's terms, holder the organisation. Not reviewed by a person.
terms.quote: Crawling the public parts of the API is allowed. HTTP 429 ("backoff") status codes are used for rate-limiting. Up to a handful concurrent requests should be ok.
terms.republish: links and metadata only, credited to the organisation, under the platform's terms; no post text or media republished
terms.open_question: Dinis to confirm the Bluesky terms (https://bsky.social/about/support/tos) are enough for links plus metadata, and which more organisation accounts to add (register/social-accounts.json notes).

code: the collector reads each listed account's recent posts and a keyword pass on Bluesky, keeps only links and metadata, and writes latest.json and reads.json
GitHub Actions runs it and deploys the site
agents: data.b.collector@PrompTugal.dinis (Sonnet) researched the platforms' terms and the accounts and wrote the collector and this card on 18 November 2026, for data.b@PrompTugal.dinis
people: Dinis Cruz decided the social signals on 18 November 2026 (board/guidance/2026-11-18-social-signals.md); no person has checked the accounts or values yet (not reviewed)

cost.runner: GitHub Actions on a public repository: no charge; about 10 requests a run (measured locally, 18 November 2026)
cost.note: Code only: no model is called when the data is collected.
